title: On the Farm
description: An shows us the animals on his farm.
instructions: Read about An's farm. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🐄 An lives on a farm with his grandma. It is a big farm.
There are four cows and two horses in the field. The cows are black and white.
There are ten chickens next to the barn. An gives them food every morning.
Grandma has got a small brown dog. Its name is Max.
Under a tree, there is a pig. It is pink and very fat. An says, 'Hello, Pinky!'
